sections.Profile:
"Monte Carlo" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in March 1973. Designed by Jim Patla with artwork by Dave Christensen, the game features a casino theme, incorporating elements such as two kickout holes, six scoring slingshots, and an infield special.
